name: s424
signature: int s424(const int *a, int *array, int n)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup. Retain the explicitly reviewed post-loop computation.

arrays.name: array
arrays.allocation: The mathematical required element count times sizeof(int) must fit SIZE_MAX and the supplied allocation.

scalar_output.source_computation: temp = 0.; for (int i = 0; i < LEN; i++){ temp += xx[i]; }

contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added. Derived pointer views share their base buffer, may overlap it, and are not restrict-qualified.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.notes: Preserve the true 64-element recurrence between array[i] reads and xx[i+1] writes. The post-loop sum includes xx[0], which the computational loop does not overwrite.

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
expose postlude's scalar observation as the return value
one backing buffer per storage object; preserve derived pointer aliases and induction without restrict
remove only the explicitly reviewed benchmark initialization; caller supplies the initial state
retain reviewed post-loop summation; replace global temp by a returned local checksum

testing.description: Data in [-3,3]; zero, one, minus-one, alternating, and seeded random trials.
